lead_independence.headline: Fourth arrest made in Fort Pierce infant death case as father charged in Virginia
lead_independence.lead: Jason Gunter, 45, was arrested by the U.S. Marshals Service at his home in Mechanicsville, Virginia, on Tuesday on an outstanding warrant obtained by St. Lucie County Sheriff's Office detectives. Gunter is charged with felony child neglect with great harm for his alleged role in the circumstances surrounding the death of his 3-month-old son in August 2025. Gunter is being held without bond in the Hanover County Jail, awaiting extradition to St. Lucie County.

lead_independence.lead: St. Lucie County Sheriff's Office deputies executed a search warrant Tuesday as part of the ongoing investigation into the Southern Truss fraud case. Crime scene investigators were seen outside the home of Laura Beth Grasso in the Indian River Estates neighborhood near Sunset Boulevard. Grasso has pleaded not guilty to the charges.

article_framing_rejections.headline: Father arrested in Virginia in connection with Fort Pierce infant malnutrition death

lead_independence.headline: Father arrested in Virginia in connection with Fort Pierce infant malnutrition death
lead_independence.lead: The U.S. Marshals Service arrested 45-year-old Jason Gunter at his home in Mechanicsville, Virginia, in connection with the death of his 3-month-old son, who died from severe dehydration and malnutrition. Gunter has been charged with felony child neglect causing great harm and is awaiting extradition to St. Lucie County. The arrest came after three others were previously charged in the case: the child's mother, 27-year-old Nicole Maxwell, the child's grandfather, Robert Maxwell, and Robert Maxwell's girlfriend, 38-year-old Vikki Koon.
